payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Alysa, Shantel

payload.content: Hi Alysa, I'm Shantel. I have strong skills in infrastructure (1.0) and mobile-development (0.69). My lowest cost is for ISSUE-0001::triage (3.59), but I can also handle ISSUE-0002 tasks. What are your skills and preferences?

Hi Shantel! I'm Alysa. My top skills are infrastructure (0.94) and data-science (0.85). My lowest costs are for the ISSUE-0002 tasks, specifically ISSUE-0002::review (4.03), ISSUE-0002::test (5.64), and ISSUE-0002::implement (8.06). Since you mentioned your lowest cost is ISSUE-0001::triage, I'm happy to take one of the ISSUE-0002 tasks. I'll aim for ISSUE-0002::implement since it has a higher effort/priority and I have the capacity (10h), but I'm open to others if you prefer a specific one from that set. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi Alysa, thanks for the update! Since you are well-suited for ISSUE-0002::implement and I have a low cost for ISSUE-0001::triage, I will plan to take ISSUE-0001::triage. This seems to be the most efficient distribution. (phase=planning, iter=1)
Sounds like a plan, Shantel. I will commit to ISSUE-0002::implement in the execution phase. Thanks for coordinating! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi Alysa, I noticed Junie also claimed ISSUE-0002::implement on Blackboard 2. To avoid a violation, please double-check your target task. I am still planning to take ISSUE-0001::triage. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi Shantel, thanks for the heads-up about Junie on Blackboard 2. I hadn't seen that yet. Since Junie is also eyeing ISSUE-0002::implement, I will pivot to ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::review to avoid a conflict and ensure we maximize completed tasks. I'll check Blackboard 2 to coordinate with Junie. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Shantel, it seems I don't have access to Blackboard 2 to talk to Junie. Could you please relay to Junie that I'm happy to let them have ISSUE-0002::implement and that I'll pivot to ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::review instead? Thanks! (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi Alysa, I've relayed your message to Junie on Blackboard 2. Junie is aware that you are pivoting to ISSUE-0002::test or ISSUE-0002::review. I'm still on track for ISSUE-0001::triage. (phase=planning, iter=1)

Hi Shantel, thanks for relaying that message. I will settle on ISSUE-0002::test for the execution phase, as it's a higher priority/effort than review and fits well within my availability and skills. I'll leave ISSUE-0002::review open for others. (phase=planning, iter=1)
